info.name: DummyJSON API Quality Suite
info.description: Risk-based functional API quality suite for the documented DummyJSON health, authentication, and product capabilities. This foundation release implements only HEALTH-001; the remaining descriptive folders intentionally contain no placeholder requests.

item.name: 00 - Health Check
item.description: Connectivity and service-availability checks that run before dependent functional scenarios.

request.description: Verifies that the documented DummyJSON test route is reachable and returns its documented GET response.

exec: pm.test('Response body is valid JSON', function () {

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: Authentication contract and characterization coverage. Requests will be added in a later implementation phase.

item.name: Positive
item.description: Successful login, current-user, and refresh-session workflows.

item.name: Negative
item.description: Invalid, missing, and malformed authentication scenarios.

item.name: 02 - Products CRUD
item.description: Documented product reads and explicitly simulated, non-persistent write operations.

item.name: Read
item.description: Product list, dynamic fixture discovery, and single-product retrieval.

item.name: Create
item.description: Simulated product creation without persistence assumptions.

item.name: Update
item.description: Simulated PUT and PATCH operations without persistence assumptions.

item.name: Delete
item.description: Simulated deletion and deletion-metadata validation without persistence assumptions.

item.name: 03 - Search Filtering and Pagination
item.description: Product discovery and relational query behavior without fixed catalog totals or mutable fixtures.

item.name: Search
item.description: Search response contracts and separately baselined matching characterization.

item.name: Categories
item.description: Dynamic category discovery and category-filtered product checks.

item.name: Pagination
item.description: Pagination, page comparison, field selection, and limit-zero behavior.

item.name: 04 - Error Handling
item.description: Undocumented malformed-input and unsupported-operation behavior, implemented only after exploratory characterization.
